name: @bossnyumba/regulator-sim
description: Regulator-readiness simulation for the BossNyumba real-estate operating system. Audit-replay over a date range asserting decision invariants (chain-of-thought present, bilingual en/sw reason notes, model-card freshness, four-eye distinct approvers, fairness deltas) across lease / rent / payout decisions, plus Tanzania PDPA subject-access and erasure drills (legal-hold aware) and a deterministic property-regulator supervision document pack. Pure domain logic behind injected ports — no DB / SDK / network / env access.
